title: SKE Bar Fruit Medley Prefilled Vape Pod
description: This Fruit Medley pod for the SKE Bar Prefilled Pod Kit blends a range of sweet, juicy fruit notes in a well-rounded vape. Expect a vibrant fruit profile with both tropical and orchard-style flavours layered into a single smooth draw. Each pod includes 2ml of 20mg nic salt and mesh coil technology for consistent flavour and satisfying MTL performance. Please Note: These are pods ONLY and the Battery is not included.
